parsed.summary: The PR addresses the issue of dash offset not working for patch objects, but it may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of dash patterns for all patch objects, which could potentially break existing code that relies on the traditional behavior of ignoring dash offsets.
The PR does not include any tests to verify that the change does not introduce regressions or that the dash offset works as expected for different types of patch objects.
